# FairLendKit

> FairLendKit is a reproducible fair-lending audit toolkit for credit decisioning systems. It produces statistical evidence for practitioner review and does not determine fairness, causation, legality, or compliance.

## Start here

- [README](README.md): implemented capabilities, quick start, non-goals, status, and release evidence
- [Core concepts](docs/core-concepts.md): semantic validation, metrics, reliability, uncertainty, flags, and reproducible reporting
- [FAQ](docs/faq.md): direct answers for practitioners and researchers
- [Limitations](docs/limitations.md): interpretation, data, scope, and communication boundaries

## Important boundaries

Current output is a renderer-neutral typed result and canonical JSON. Threshold scanning, HTML/CSV renderers, a CLI, proxy-risk screening, governance integration, and mitigation are not implemented. Research protocols and results do not become product capabilities merely by existing in this repository.
